stem: Which principle best distinguishes integrated pest management from reacting to every observation with the same control tactic?
choices: IPM combines prevention, identification, monitoring, thresholds, compatible controls, and verification rather than relying on one repeated response
IPM requires treating every plant on a fixed calendar regardless of scouting
IPM ignores environmental and sanitation factors
IPM is complete once a pest name is guessed
rationale: Integrated pest management is a decision process that combines prevention, accurate identification, monitoring, thresholds, multiple compatible tactics, and evaluation of results.
